account_or_segment: Connected + first order / no repeat pairs
signal: First order happened but repeat did not
trigger: Expected reorder window or recent first order
why_this_lead: Intent was proven once so repeat failure is more actionable than cold conversion
conversation_direction: What would make you buy from this supplier again online?
expected_outcome: Second/third order path or clear blocker
expected_learning: What breaks repeat procurement after initial trust
review_question: Which pairs should be worked first and who owns the touch?

signal: Connection accepted but no first order
why_this_lead: Intent exists but buying motion broke before first order
conversation_direction: What did you expect to find or buy and what stopped you?
expected_outcome: First-order blocker classified and one next step agreed
expected_learning: Whether connection intent fails because of supply price trust terms habit timing or tool friction
review_question: Which pairs are still current enough to call?

signal: Buying intent but low online conversion
trigger: Recent procurement activity search click or buyer request
why_this_lead: Can reveal what buyers want to source and what would make online buying useful
conversation_direction: What are you trying to source and what would make that routine easier through Koronet?
expected_outcome: Buying need captured and routed to supply connection or pricing action
expected_learning: What would help buyers buy better online
review_question: Which intent signals are real enough to prioritize?

account_or_segment: Buyer buys online and offline from similar suppliers
why_this_lead: Best path to understand leakage and which routines are realistic to digitalize
conversation_direction: Which orders are easier online and which still need call text negotiation or manual sourcing?
expected_outcome: Leakage reason classified and route to LIST SELL Product or account plan
expected_learning: Which patterns can be digitized vs need product/process change
review_question: Can Rose identify this behavior reliably?

signal: Online supply may not match what the wholesaler sells offline
why_this_lead: Buyers cannot buy online what is not listed in the right format and time window
conversation_direction: Which top products sell offline but are not reliably visible online?
expected_outcome: One supply readiness pilot candidate or data blocker
expected_learning: Whether format variety time depth freshness or fulfillment is binding
review_question: Which account has enough readiness to pilot?

account_or_segment: Already selling online with incomplete coverage
signal: Proof of online selling but likely remaining supply gaps
trigger: Strong online behavior or active online clients
why_this_lead: Lower activation risk and strongest improvement candidate
conversation_direction: What is working online today and what supply gaps still force buyers to call?
expected_learning: What to improve in accounts already capable of online selling
review_question: Which strong seller is best to improve first?

why_this_lead: Learning accounts show what good supply looks like
conversation_direction: What makes this online catalog useful: format time depth freshness competitiveness buyer base?
expected_learning: What to copy and what does not transfer
review_question: Which patterns are transferable to normal eShop/eSuite accounts?

account_or_segment: API sellers with strong online buying behavior
signal: Buyers transact online through API workflow
why_this_lead: Useful to learn what buyers buy online but not how to run eShop catalog operations
conversation_direction: Which formats categories and time windows do buyers actually purchase online?
expected_outcome: Demand pattern for LIST and BUY questions
expected_learning: What buyers value online independent of eShop workflow
review_question: What can we learn without assuming API workflow transfers?

signal: Near-term implementation with incomplete readiness fields
trigger: Contract started Jul 9 2026 and seed shows readiness gaps
why_this_lead: Early usage path can prevent setup-only implementation
conversation_direction: What is the first real usage path after setup: buy list sell or repeat?
expected_outcome: Commercial readiness path defined or routed to support
expected_learning: Whether setup has a credible usage motion
review_question: Does Christine agree this needs TX support?

why_this_lead: TX can help shape usage before go-live habits form
conversation_direction: Which customer workflow should prove value first and what must be ready before marketing?
expected_outcome: First usage path and measurement plan
expected_learning: How to make go-live create a real habit not only setup
review_question: Is this the right implementation row to help?

signal: Meaningful online behavior signal and learning potential
why_this_lead: Better first GROW candidate than generic size-only accounts
conversation_direction: Which existing online buyer cohort should repeat more often and what message/supply moment should trigger it?
expected_learning: What makes good online behavior grow further
review_question: Approve as first measured play or keep as study?

signal: Facu-confirmed strategic account in Cata/Chris lane
trigger: Cata already working and needs one account-level plan
why_this_lead: Should not receive fragmented initiative asks
conversation_direction: What is the account-level plan across BUY LIST SELL and GROW and which conversation happens first?
expected_outcome: One next conversation owner ask and date
expected_learning: Which lane is binding for this top account
review_question: What is current status and where should Facu help?

trigger: Need current facts and one next conversation
why_this_lead: Complex accounts need full-stack account plan not default initiative execution
conversation_direction: Which one blocker or objective should align before any initiative ask?
expected_outcome: Account plan update or blocker owner/date
expected_learning: Whether they are ready to amplify or still diagnose
review_question: Which blocker/next conversation should be locked?

signal: Product enabler tied to blocker account pilot and KPI
trigger: Only when an initiative blocker repeats and is measurable
why_this_lead: Prevents roadmap debate disconnected from execution
conversation_direction: Which blocker prevents BUY LIST SELL or GROW and how would we test it?
expected_outcome: Park pilot or Monday leadership discussion
expected_learning: Whether the issue is product process value prop or account-specific
review_question: Is this account-backed enough to discuss Friday?
